description: Guard optional humanity dialogue icons against missing or rearranged E3 widgets; remove from the actual compound owner, preserve horizontal layout requirements, and bound ancestor traversal without altering dialogue or humanity gameplay.

edits.find:
let parent: ref<inkHorizontalPanel> = this.m_TextFlex.GetParentWidget() as inkHorizontalPanel;
		parent.RemoveChild(this.m_humanityLossHolder);
edits.replace:
let parent: ref<inkCompoundWidget> = this.m_humanityLossHolder.GetParentWidget() as inkCompoundWidget;
		if IsDefined(parent) { parent.RemoveChild(this.m_humanityLossHolder); }

edits.find:
let parent: ref<inkHorizontalPanel> = this.m_TextFlex.GetParentWidget() as inkHorizontalPanel;
	let hubVert: ref<inkVerticalPanel> = parent.GetParentWidget().GetParentWidget().GetParentWidget().GetParentWidget() as inkVerticalPanel;
